messages:
Alex H: Quick async — rapid capacity check for morning traffic spike. Did: moved 8 nodes from standby->active in us-west2, patched driver 525.85 on the new nodes.
Mira G: Thanks. Did you already validate PCIe lanes on those hosts? Last time one came up with misconfigured BIOS.
Alex H: Yep ran the hw-check script, output looked clean. snippet: `./hw-check.sh --gpus` returned `OK x8` on all.
Sam R: Noted. Blocker: spot eviction rate in eu-central jumped to 18% overnight, autoscaler kept retrying and caused transient throttles.
Lina P: Is that on the p4a pool or gp4? We saw a similar pattern when mixing preemptible and reserved.
Sam R: Mostly p4a spot. I suspect a cloud-side maintenance wave. I opened a support ticket (CLD-4521) and left a note in the AZ.
Jorge V: For short term can we route eu traffic to eu-west3 overflow? We have spare reserved there (~12 GPUs).
Alex H: I bumped routing policy to prefer eu-west3 for non-low-latency tiers at 06:14 UTC. Observability shows drop in queue wait.
Mira G: Can you paste the quick query you used so SRE can monitor?
Alex H: `SELECT region, sum(active_gpus) FROM fleet_snapshot WHERE ts > now() - interval '5 minutes' GROUP BY region;` gave eu-west3 +12, eu-central -10.
capacity-bot: [automated] autoscale-event: 2026-03-17T06:16:02Z scale_down_cancelled for pool=eu-central-p4a reason=high_eviction_rate
Lina P: FYI I updated the prewarm config for dev clusters to keep 2 warm nodes instead of 0 — should shave cold starts for CI.
Sam R: Follow-up: can we add a fallback to use smaller batch sizes when eviction > 10% to reduce retries? Might help tail latency.
Jorge V: +1. Proposal: when eviction_rate > 10% and queue_length > 20, set max_batch_tokens=512 and reduce concurrency by 25%.
Mira G: Sounds reasonable. Can someone open a quick RFC PR so we have an audit trail? I can review.
Alex H: I'll open PR with the rule and the metric thresholds, linking CLD-4521.
Sam R: Blocker cleared for me — waiting on cloud support response but overflow routing stabilizes traffic.
Mira G: Today: I'll run a broader quota reconciliation across EU regions and request bump if needed.
Lina P: Today: I'll finish the Canary test for the new kernel build and ship notes to eng-runtime.
Jorge V: Today: monitor spot trend for next 6h and trigger spillover if eviction persists.
Alex H: Thanks team — ping me if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
